gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1183 opened 2024 with gross claims outstanding of $1,920.8m. During 2024 there was adverse prior-year development totalling $125.2m (6.5% of opening gross reserves), primarily attributable to deterioration on prior years (mainly the 2021 underwriting year). The movements were driven by adverse claims development and large-loss development across direct lines and reinsurance acceptances, partially offset by releases in some direct classes. Notable 2024 catastrophe events included Hurricane Helene, Hurricane Milton and the Oklahoma Tornadoes; Russia-Ukraine exposures also contributed to reserving uncertainty.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are reported in the native currency (USD) and converted from the statements presented in thousands. The report uses parentheses to denote adverse prior-year movements (deteriorations) in the Movement table; these have been interpreted per the narrative ('Adverse movements amounting to $125,152k') so that parenthesised figures in the movement table are treated as strengthenings (positive) in this JSON. Mapping of regulatory LOB names to the standard Lloyd's LOB list was applied where a clear mapping existed; 'Credit and suretyship' was mapped to 'Professional Lines' as the closest standard category. Percentages are rounded to two decimals. Confidence values reflect explicit statements or direct table extractions.
